verses.sanskrit:
सहदेव उवाच।
              यदेतत्कथितं राज्ञा धर्म एष सनातनः। यथा च युद्धमेव स्यात्तथा कार्यमरिन्दम ॥१॥
verses.english: Sahadeva said All this which has been said by the king is eternal virtue; but, O chastiser of foes, should act in that way by which there shall be war.

verses.sanskrit: यदि प्रशममिच्छेयुः कुरवः पाण्डवैः सह। तथाऽपि युद्धं दाशार्ह योजयेथाः सहैव तैः ॥२॥
verses.english: If even the sons of Kuru desire peace with the sons of Pandu, still do you provoke war with them, O you of the Dasharha race.

verses.sanskrit: कथं नु दृष्ट्वा पाञ्चालीं तथा कृष्ण सभागताम्। अवधेन प्रशाम्येत मम मन्युः सुयोधने ॥३॥
verses.english: Having seen the princess of Panchala come in the assembly, O Krishna, annoyed in that fashion, how can my wrath towards Suyodhana be appeased without killing him?

verses.sanskrit: यदि भीमार्जुनौ कृष्ण धर्मराजश्च धार्मिकः। धर्ममुत्सृज्य तेनाहं योद्धमिच्छामि संयुगे ॥४॥
verses.english: If Bhima and Arjuna, O Krishna and the virtuous king are virtuous, then I leading the path of virtue desire to fight with him in battle.

verses.sanskrit: सात्यकिरुवाच। सत्यमाह महाबाहो सहदेवो महामतिः। दुर्योधनवधे शान्तिस्तस्य कोपस्य मे भवेत् ॥५॥
verses.english: Satyaki said Sahadeva of large mind has spoken the truth, O you of long arms. His wrath and mine will be appeased only by killing Duryodhana.
verses.bhavadeepa: यदि यद्यपि भीमादयो धार्मिकाः स्युस्तथाऽप्यहं धर्ममुत्सृज्य तेन सह योद्धुमिच्छामि ॥४॥

verses.sanskrit: न जानासि यथा दृष्ट्वा चीराजिनधरान् वने। तवापि मन्युरुद्भूतो दुःखितान् प्रेक्ष्य पाण्डवान् ॥६॥
verses.english: Do you not know that you, too seeing the Pandavas clad in rags and deer skin in the forest, felt very sorry and your wrath was kindled

verses.sanskrit: तस्मान्माद्रीसुतः शूरो यदाह रणकर्कशः। वचनं सर्वयोधानां तन्मतं पुरुषोत्तम ॥७॥
verses.english: Therefore what the heroic son of Madri terrific in battle has said is the opinion of all the soldiers, O you foremost of men.

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              एवं वदति वाक्यं तु युयुधाने महामतौ। सुभीमः सिंहनादोऽभूद्योधानां तत्र सर्वशः ॥८॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said While Suyodhana of large mind was yet speaking such, a terrible roar like that of a lion came from all the soldiers assembled there.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे हि सर्वशो वीरास्तद्वचः प्रत्यपूजयन्। साधु साध्विति शैनेयं हर्षयन्तो युयुत्सवः ॥९॥
verses.english: And all the heroes accepted and honoured these words of his in every way saying-Well done, well done; and the soldiers desirous of battle expressed their joy.
